_doc: The translation sync marker. On the source branch (this one) lang is null: there is nothing to keep in sync. A translate-<lang> branch sets lang (e.g. 'pt') and upstream (the canonical content branch it tracks: 'main' in the standalone release, 'nemoclaw-only' when served from the s-fx-43-v1 bundle), then runs translation_status.py --set-base <upstream-tip> to pin base_sha to the source commit the translation reflects. translation_status.py reads this to show what changed upstream since base_sha.
